title: Refusal to perform and avoidable loss
shortTitle: Refusal to perform and avoidable loss
summary: An announced refusal to perform can require the injured party to decide whether further performance will create avoidable loss.
notes: Rockingham County concerns continued construction after a communicated repudiation. Its damages discussion separates loss already caused from expense unnecessarily increased afterward. The syllabus does not assign the casebook’s complete separate chapter treatment of prospective nonperformance.

textbookImport.basis: Plain-language synthesis of the cited casebook passages; subject to the jurisdictional and source limits stated there.
